lines.l: I'm here on this ride, in and out of love with you
Is it me? I just can't find my way
Tied up with you inside this big mistake
Now I see you were never meant for me
Can't keep singing the same old song
Can't keep my head above water
I've done all that I can do
Getting out of love with you
From the north side to Bronzeville, to the south shore, I'm headed home.
From the loop up to the lakefront, to the south side, I'm headed home.
